tools.name: binary_cube_run_subcube_strength_matrix
tools.description: Run a bounded comparative strengthening matrix across payload classes, subcube modes, fan-outs and canonical Binary Cube configurations; returns ranked improvements/regressions and per-fan-out summaries.
tools.outputDescription: Machine-readable matrix summary, per-fan-out aggregate diffusion deltas, ranked best/worst cases, exact-round-trip state, findings and all individual results.

notes: Matrix results are comparative diagnostics, not proof of cryptographic security.
A candidate should not be promoted merely because some configurations improve; inspect regressions, expansion cost and exact recovery across the matrix.
